info.title: Cedros Login API
info.description: Authentication and authorization service supporting JWT tokens, API keys, Solana wallet auth, and organization management.

servers.description: Default mount path (adjust based on your deployment)

get.description: Returns available authentication methods and usage instructions. Designed for AI agents to discover how to authenticate.

post.description: Requests a passwordless sign-in link by email. Always returns a generic success message to prevent email enumeration.

post.summary: Verify instant sign-in link and login
post.description: Verifies a one-time token from an instant sign-in email. On success returns an authenticated session (cookies) and/or tokens. If the user has MFA enabled, returns an MFA-required response.
Request a challenge nonce to sign with your Solana wallet. This is the first step in Solana wallet authentication.
Complete authentication by submitting the signed challenge. Returns JWT tokens and API key for new users.
Invalidates the current API key and generates a new one. The new key is returned in full only once.

get.description: Returns metadata for all API keys belonging to the current user.

post.description: Creates a new API key with a label. The full key is returned only once.

delete.description: Deletes a specific API key. If a wallet was linked to this key, it becomes orphaned.

get.description: Returns all wallets for the current user, including the default wallet and per-API-key wallets.

post.description: Deletes the current wallet and creates a new one with a new keypair. This is irreversible — any funds at the old address are NOT migrated.

get.summary: Check if initial setup is required
get.description: Returns whether the system needs first-run setup (no admin exists). No authentication required.

post.description: Creates the initial admin account. Only works when no admin users exist; returns 403 afterwards.
Creates a new Stripe Identity session and returns a redirect URL for the user.

get.description: Returns the authenticated user's current KYC verification status.
Returns the authenticated user's current accredited investor status.

post.description: Creates a new accreditation submission for admin review.
Accepts multipart/form-data with fields: submissionId, documentType, file. Max 10 MB.

400.description: Missing fields or unsupported file type

get.description: Returns the authenticated user's submission history, paginated.
Returns aggregated rewards earned, pending amounts, and payout wallet for the authenticated user.
Returns paginated history of referral rewards (payouts or credit transactions).

post.summary: Set or clear payout wallet address
post.description: Sets the Solana wallet address for receiving direct referral payouts. Pass null to clear.
Generates a single-use invite code for the authenticated user to share.

get.description: Returns all access codes generated by the authenticated user.

post.description: Processes Stripe Identity webhook events. Requires a valid Stripe-Signature header.

parameters.name: Stripe-Signature
parameters.description: Stripe webhook signature for request verification

get.summary: Get KYC status and session history for a user

404.description: User or KYC service not found

post.description: Manually sets the KYC status for a user, bypassing the normal verification flow.

get.description: Returns all submissions in 'pending' status (oldest first) for admin review.

get.summary: Get accreditation record for a user
get.description: Returns aggregate accreditation status and submission history for a user.
Returns full submission detail including documents.

get.summary: Get presigned URL for an accreditation document
get.description: Returns a short-lived presigned S3 URL (15 minutes) for downloading the document.

post.summary: Approve or reject an accreditation submission

post.description: Manually sets the accreditation status for a user, bypassing the review flow.

get.description: Returns the number of sanctioned addresses/countries cached and the cache age.

post.description: Forces an immediate refresh of the sanctions cache from the configured API.

get.summary: Get compliance status for a user
get.description: Returns KYC status, accredited investor flag, and token gate result. Designed for service-to-service calls.
Returns all access codes with optional type filter.

parameters.name: code_type
parameters.description: Filter by code type (e.g. limited, user)

post.description: Creates a new limited-use code. The code string must not be empty.

get.summary: Get signup statistics for the current period
get.description: Returns the number of registrations in the current period vs the configured limit.
Returns aggregate referral counts, payout totals, and top affiliates.

get.summary: List pending referral payouts grouped by referrer

post.summary: Execute all pending referral payouts on-chain
post.description: Aggregates and transfers pending referral rewards to each referrer's payout wallet.

post.summary: Reset failed referral payouts to pending

get.description: Paginated list of all individual payout records with optional status filter.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Filter by status: pending, processing, completed, failed, cancelled

post.description: Executes an individual pending or failed payout on-chain.

400.description: Payout cannot be cancelled in current state

signature.description: Base58-encoded Ed25519 signature of the nonce

apiKey.description: API key (only returned for new users)

apiKeyLabel.description: Label of linked API key, or null for default wallet

WalletRotateRequest.description: Same structure as WalletEnrollRequest — provides new wallet material for the rotated wallet.

needsSetup.description: True when no admin user exists yet

redirectUrl.description: URL to redirect the user to for identity verification

expiryDays.description: Custom expiry in days from now (overrides default setting)

totalEarned.description: Total rewards earned in smallest unit

walletAddress.description: Base58-encoded 32-byte Solana public key, or null to clear

count.description: Users registered in the current period

addressCount.description: Number of sanctioned addresses currently cached

countryCount.description: Number of blocked country codes currently cached

cacheAgeSecs.description: Seconds since last refresh, null if never refreshed

tokenGated.description: True when all token gate rules pass (or gating is disabled)

items.description: Aggregated pending payout summary per referrer
